customManagers.description: golangci-lint image pinned as a named const in ci/main.go — not a file Renovate's built-in managers look inside.
gitleaks image, same pin dafs's own ci/main.go tracks — kept in lockstep across the ecosystem, so bump both repos together when Renovate opens either PR.
cyclonedx-gomod version used to generate the SBOM.

packageRules.description: golang:1.26 in ci/main.go's goBase/buildBase should track this repo's go.mod, not bump ahead of it unattended — leave that one manual.

github.com/coredns/caddy's v2.x tags declare their own module path as github.com/caddyserver/caddy/v2 (the real, much larger upstream Caddy web server) rather than github.com/coredns/caddy/v2 — a path collision, not a genuine v2 release of this fork's tiny Caddyfile-tokenizer library, which is still v1.1.x. Renovate can't tell the difference and keeps reopening a bump that fails go mod tidy and would pull in the wrong dependency entirely if forced through.
